verdict.rationale: The evidence only implies office-document conversion. CloudConvert lets users pin a LibreOffice version for conversions, and it can combine files including 'documents' into a single PDF. No item explicitly names Word, Excel, or PowerPoint formats, or conversion between office formats. Missing for 10: explicit DOCX/XLSX/PPTX-to-PDF support, conversion between office formats (e.g., DOC↔DOCX, XLSX↔ODS), a format coverage list, and independent or hands-on corroboration of fidelity.

support.subject: As a power user, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files convert to PDF and between office formats

citations.quote: you can set a fixed LibreOffice version, which ensures that this version is used even if we update the default version of LibreOffice.
Combine multiple files of any format (PDFs, images, documents) in one single PDF
